title: Fixed Single Group Countertop Coffee Machine
description: Original fixed single-group countertop coffee appliance, with four grounded pads and chassis, plain body, group-head shoulder and cylinder, locked filter bowl and separate grip, fixed delivery tip, parked rigid steam wand, opaque abstract controls and a true shallow drip well supporting a continuous grate with 11 actual through-slots. Static editable components only; no portafilter removal/rotation, steam-wand movement, brewing, heat, pressure, water, electricity or food-safety capability. A separate validated display uses the unchanged original kitchen mug at unit scale and original worktable; finite mug-height/offset and machine-overhang fixtures are diagnostic only.
